group Roles & responsibilities

Level 1 Support

First contact, categorisation, prioritisation and quick fixes.

Resolve or escalate quickly
Level 2 Support

In-depth analysis, advanced troubleshooting and workarounds.

Resolve complex issues
Level 3 Support

Specialist engineering, root-cause analysis and permanent resolution.

Resolve critical issues
Support Manager

Monitors escalations and SLAs, removes roadblocks and communicates.

Ensure timely resolution
Vendor / Partner

Tracks external cases and coordinates the vendor resolution.

Bring external expertise

priority_high Severity matrix Example

SeverityDescriptionLevel involvedResponseResolution
S1 CriticalService down or major outage; no workaroundL1 → L2 → L3 → Manager → Vendor15–30 min4–8 hrs
S2 HighMajor impact or partial service disruptionL1 → L2 → L3 → Manager30 min–1 hr8–24 hrs
S3 MediumMinor impact or feature degradationL1 → L2 → L31–4 hrs1–3 days
S4 LowGeneral enquiry, request or how-toL1 → L24–8 hrs1–5 days

Targets vary by service plan and the applicable SLA.
